run_pos_tag_cli: run the pos_tag module with --input, --output, and --dataset-name args to tag POS
run_open_files: run open_files to read the first 2000 lines of target and source dataset files
run_tag_and_write: run tag_and_write to POS-tag target lines with spaCy and write 6 output files
run_file_writer: run file_writer to write a list of lines to a file with newline separators
review_tag_and_write: review tag_and_write to understand how verbs, nouns, and adjectives are extracted and saved
